title: CBDC Ban Has a 2030 Expiration Date
script_summary:
**ORACLE BRIEF**

Senate just banned CBDCs with an 89-to-10 vote—and buried a 2030 sunset clause inside the text. That's not a win. That's a scheduled rematch.

Three pressure systems are converging. Arthur Hayes is positioning for prolonged US-Iran conflict—not equities, not gold, just Bitcoin. Rate cut expectations moved nine percent to thirty-five percent in three weeks. The Fed is now stuck. Meanwhile, Nick Batia's calling 2026 the largest corporate bond issuance year in history.
